summary: Approved exact current commit 31d4e2bf0379fe7bceab4fe9f038987e3b3c6226 with no unresolved final-review finding. The focused delta fully resolves both prior accessibility blockers: selected evidence, missing-target, and duplicate-inert destination headings no longer suppress focus styling and now receive a persistent 3px visible outline when programmatically focused; every Return control restores focus to the exact invoking evidence reference; and evidence navigation consults prefers-reduced-motion and requests scrollIntoView behavior auto rather than smooth when reduction is enabled. The committed browser suite now asserts destination focus and computed outline visibility for all three states, exact focus return, and the non-animated reduced-motion path. Independent testing passed the complete 28-test unit/component suite and all 16 Playwright desktop/mobile cases, including axe, responsive, retry/fallback, duplicate-integrity, and real credential-free Vite-to-FastAPI proxy coverage; this review independently reran the eight focused desktop/mobile browser cases on Node.js 24.19.0 and all passed. The delta introduces no dependency, contract, backend, network, credential, persistence, or security-boundary change. Commit-bound verification is PASSED at 79f189720b0930cac2aeb0aec4a25bf52d699734 and security APPROVED e25865b315f33cf1d4a3c6f573fbca0ad4062dca; later commits contain only the permitted refreshed verification and security reports, so both evidence chains are current for this reviewed HEAD.
